claim.scope_statement: Reports Guan's arXiv:2607.22981v2 finite positive vertex-centroid regularization and reachability theorem, with its immobility-at-coincidence convention, orientation qualifications, and preprint status. The area-centroid variant and effective move-count/algorithmic bounds are not resolved; no new global reachability theorem is claimed.
